12316-true-tilda.title: True Tilda
12316-true-tilda.creator: Unknown
12316-true-tilda.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The figure in the next bed stirred feebly; the figure of a woman, straight and gaunt under the hospital bedclothes. A tress of her hair had come uncoiled and looped itself across the pillow--reddish auburn hair, streaked with grey. She had been brought in, three nights ago, drenched, bedraggled, chattering in a high fever; a case of acute pneumonia.

14797-the-tale-of-timmy-tiptoes.title: [Illustration]
14797-the-tale-of-timmy-tiptoes.creator: Beatrix Potter
14797-the-tale-of-timmy-tiptoes.description: A book by Beatrix Potter. The most forgetful squirrel in the wood was called Silvertail. He began to dig, and he could not remember. And then he dug again and found some nuts that did not belong to him; and there was a fight. And other squirrels began to dig,--the whole wood was in commotion!

arxiv-1602-02442.title: A Simple Practical Accelerated Method for Finite Sums
arxiv-1602-02442.creator: Aaron Defazio
arxiv-1602-02442.description: Abstract We describe a novel optimization method for finite sums (such as empirical risk minimization problems) building on the recently introduced SAGA method. Our method achieves an accelerated convergence rate on strongly convex smooth problems. Our method has only one parameter (a step size), and is radically simpler than other accelerated methods for finite sums.

arxiv-2107-13304.title: Bayesian Autoencoders: Analysing and Fixing the Bernoulli likelihood for Out-of-Distribution Detection
arxiv-2107-13304.creator: Bang Xiang Yong, Tim Pearce, Alexandra Brintrup
arxiv-2107-13304.description: Abstract After an autoencoder (AE) has learnt to reconstruct one dataset, it might be expected that the likelihood on an out-of-distribution (OOD) input would be low. This has been studied as an approach to detect OOD inputs. Recent work showed this intuitive approach can fail for the dataset pairs FashionMNIST vs MNIST.

arxiv-2111-12742.title: Generating Synthetic Systems of Interdependent Critical Infrastructure Networks
arxiv-2111-12742.creator: Yu Wang, Jin-Zhu Yu, Hiba Baroud
arxiv-2111-12742.description: Abstract The lack of data on critical infrastructure systems has hindered the research progress in modeling and optimizing the system performance. This work develops a method for generating Synthetic Interdependent Critical Infrastructure Networks (SICIN) using simulation and non-linear optimization techniques.

arxiv-2201-01474.title: Hyperon production in quasielastic ν ¯ τ − \bar{\nu}_{\tau}- nucleon scattering
arxiv-2201-01474.creator: A. Fatima, M. Sajjad Athar, S. K. Singh
arxiv-2201-01474.description: Abstract The theoretical results for the total cross sections and polarization components of the τ + \tau^{+} lepton produced in the charged current induced | Δ ​ S | = 1 |\Delta S|=1 quasielastic ν ¯ τ − N \bar{\nu}_{\tau}-N scattering leading to hyperons ( Λ , Σ \Lambda,\Sigma ) have been presented assuming T invariance.

arxiv-2401-13196.title: Stable numerics for finite-strain elasticity Publication type: Research Article Journal: International Journal for Numerical Methods in Engineering Volume: 00
arxiv-2401-13196.creator: Rezgar Shakeri, Leila Ghaffari, Jeremy L. Thompson, Jed Brown*
arxiv-2401-13196.description: Abstract A backward stable numerical calculation of a function with condition number κ \kappa will have a relative accuracy of κ ​ ϵ machine \kappa\epsilon_{\text{machine}} . Standard formulations and software implementations of finite-strain elastic materials models make use of the deformation gradient 𝑭 = I + ∂ 𝒖 / ∂ 𝑿 \bm{F}=I+\partial\bm{u}/\partial\bm{X} and Cauchy-Green tensors.

arxiv-2403-02321.title: Quantum-enhanced sensing of axion dark matter with a transmon-based single microwave photon counter
arxiv-2403-02321.creator: C. Braggio, L. Balembois, R. Di Vora, Z. Wang, J. Travesedo, L. Pallegoix, G. Carugno, A. Ortolan, G. Ruoso, U. Gambardella, D. D’Agostino, P. Bertet, E. Flurin
arxiv-2403-02321.description: Abstract We report an axion dark matter search with a haloscope equipped with a microwave photon counter. The haloscope is a tunable high quality factor 3-dimensional microwave cavity placed in a magnetic field. The photon counter, operated cyclically, maps an incoming microwave photon onto the state of a superconducting transmon qubit.

arxiv-2409-17729.title: Neural Implicit Representation for Highly Dynamic LiDAR Mapping and Odometry
arxiv-2409-17729.creator: Qi Zhang, He Wang, Ru Li, Wenbin Li
arxiv-2409-17729.description: Abstract Recent advancements in Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) have increasingly highlighted the robustness of LiDAR-based techniques. At the same time, Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) have introduced new possibilities for 3D scene reconstruction, exemplified by SLAM systems. Among these, NeRF-LOAM has shown notable performance in NeRF-based SLAM applications.

arxiv-2505-04580.title: Consensus Seminorms and their Applications
arxiv-2505-04580.creator: Ron Ofir, Ji Liu, A. Stephen Morse, Brian D. O. Anderson
arxiv-2505-04580.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ron Ofir, Ji Liu, A. Stephen Morse, Brian D. O. Anderson. Consensus is a well-studied problem in distributed sensing, computation and control, yet deriving useful and easily computable bounds on the rate of convergence to consensus remains a challenge. This paper discusses the use of seminorms for this goal. A previously suggested family of seminorms is revisited, and an error made in their original presentation is corrected, where it was claimed that the a certain seminorm is equal to the well-known coefficient of ergodicity.

arxiv-2507-06023.title: Liquid-Gas Criticality of Hyperuniform Fluids
arxiv-2507-06023.creator: Shang Gao, Hao Shang, Hao Hu, Yu-Qiang Ma, Qun-Li Lei
arxiv-2507-06023.description: Abstract In statistical physics, a well-accepted knowledge is that liquid-gas (LG) phase transition with diverging critical fluctuations lies in the universality class of Ising. Yet, whether non-equilibrium effect can alter this conclusion remains an open question. Here, we study the LG criticality of a hyperuniform (HU) fluid composed of active spinners, where phase separation is induced by dissipative collisions.

arxiv-2510-10172.title: The Turán and Delsarte problems and their duals Thanks: N.L. is supported by ISF Grant No. 1044/21. M.M. is supported by the Hungarian National Foundation for Scientific Research, Grants No. K146387 and KKP 133819.
arxiv-2510-10172.creator: Mihail N. Kolountzakis, Nir Lev, Máté Matolcsi
arxiv-2510-10172.description: Abstract . We study two optimization problems for positive definite functions on Euclidean space with restrictions on their support and sign: the Turán problem and the Delsarte problem. These problems have been studied also for their connections to geometric problems of tiling and packing. In the finite group setting the weak and strong linear duality for these problems are automatic.

arxiv-2510-25802.title: Attention Augmented GNN RNN-Attention Models for Advanced Cybersecurity Intrusion Detection
arxiv-2510-25802.creator: Jayant Biradar, Smit Shah, Tanmay Naik
arxiv-2510-25802.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jayant Biradar, Smit Shah, Tanmay Naik. In this paper, we propose a novel hybrid deep learning architecture that synergistically combines Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), Recurrent Neural Networks (RNNs), and multi-head attention mechanisms to significantly enhance cybersecurity intrusion detection capabilities. By leveraging the comprehensive UNSW-NB15 dataset containing diverse network traffic patterns, our approach effectively captures both spatial dependencies through graph structural relationships and temporal dynamics through sequential analysis of network events.

This is a robust and highly conserved sex difference that it is also observed across species including dogs, rats, mice and chickens and it is found in induced, genetic and...

pmc-10745937.title: MoS2-Based Memristor: Robust Resistive Switching Behavior and Reliable Biological Synapse Emulation
pmc-10745937.creator: Yongfa Ling, Jiexin Li, Tao Luo, Ying Lin, Guangxin Zhang, Meihua Shou, Qing Liao, Lyudmila M Bronstein
pmc-10745937.description: Memristors are recognized as crucial devices for future nonvolatile memory and artificial intelligence. Due to their typical neuron-synapse-like metal–insulator–metal(MIM) sandwich structure, they are widely used to simulate biological synapses and have great potential in advancing biological synapse simulation. However, the high switch voltage and inferior stability of the memristor restrict the broader application to the emulation of the biological synapse.

pmc-11503341.title: Respiratory Syncytial Virus in Pregnancy: An Obstetrics View
pmc-11503341.creator: Mattia Dominoni, Barbara Gardella, Arsenio Spinillo
pmc-11503341.description: nts who are premature, immunocompromised, or who have congenital heart disease, congenital lung disease, or congenital airway defects are most vulnerable to severe RSV-related conditions [4,5,6]. Compared to the general population, the incidence of RSV diseases and severe infection is higher in infants that are non-Hispanic Black, American Indian, or Alaska Native [7].

pmc-11605214.title: Comparison of Mitochondrial Genome Expression Differences among Four Skink Species Distributed at Different Latitudes under Low-Temperature Stress
pmc-11605214.creator: Lemei Zhan, Jingyi He, Lingyi Ding, Kenneth B Storey, Jiayong Zhang, Danna Yu, Atsushi Matsuzawa, Gad Degani
pmc-11605214.description: Continual climate change strongly influences temperature conditions worldwide, making ectothermic animals as suitable species for studying the potential impact of climate change on global biodiversity. However, the study of how lizards distributed at different latitudes respond to climate change at the transcriptome level is still insufficient.

pmc-11634926.title: Neurotoxin-Derived Optical Probes for Elucidating Molecular and Developmental Biology of Neurons and Synaptic Connections
pmc-11634926.creator: Rohini Bijjam, Susan Shorter, Alison M Bratt, Valerie B O’Leary, Vasilis Ntziachristos, Saak Victor Ovsepian
pmc-11634926.description: Botulinum neurotoxins (BoNTs) and tetanus toxin (TeTX) are the deadliest biological substances that cause botulism and tetanus, respectively. Their astonishing potency and capacity to enter neurons and interfere with neurotransmitter release at presynaptic terminals have attracted much interest in experimental neurobiology and clinical research.

pmc-11690832.title: HOUSING AND COMMUNITY FOR OLDER ADULTS AS AGING IN PLACE (AIP) ENABLER: AN INTERNATIONAL PERSPECTIVE
pmc-11690832.creator: Sojung Park, Tine Buffel
pmc-11690832.description: This symposium discusses various approaches from five different countries that enable Aging in Place (AIP) through housing and community. The achievement of AIP depends on the institutional and cultural context. A study from New Zealand focuses on making new small homes accessible, and shows while accessible design is considered good design, not everyone understands it.

pmc-12430347.title: Investigation of Viscoelastic Properties of Macrophage Membrane–Cytoskeleton Induced by Gold Nanorods in Leishmania Infection
pmc-12430347.creator: Maria L. B. Pertence, Marina V. Guedes, Rosimeire C. Barcelos, Jeronimo N. Rugani, Rodrigo P. Soares, Joyce L. V. Cruz, Alessandra M. de Sousa, Rubens L. do Monte-Neto, Livia G. Siman, Anna C. P. Lage, Ubirajara Agero
pmc-12430347.description: Cell membranes and the cytoskeleton play crucial roles in the regulation of cellular responses by mediating mechanical forces and physical stimuli from the microenvironment through their viscoelastic properties. Investigating these properties provides valuable insights into disease mechanisms and therapeutic strategies. Gold nanorods (GNRs), especially under irradiation, exhibit lethal effects against Leishmania parasites through plasmonic photothermal conversion.

pmc-12843994.title: Uncovering Structure–Conductivity Relationships in Anion Exchange Membranes (AEMs) Using Interpretable Machine Learning
pmc-12843994.creator: Pegah Naghshnejad, Debojyoti Das, Jose A. Romagnoli, Revati Kumar, Jianhua Chen
pmc-12843994.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Anion exchange membranes (AEMs) play a vital role in the performance of water electrolyzers and fuel cells, yet their discovery and optimization remain challenging due to the complexity of structure–property relationships. In this study, we introduce a machine learning framework that leverages conditional graph neural networks (cGNNs) and descriptor-based models and a hybrid graph neural network (HGARE) to predict and interpret ionic conductivity.

pmc-12905973.title: Psychometric of the Ferrer-Urbina multidimensional scale of sexual self concept (MSSSC) in the Iranian population
pmc-12905973.creator: Yeganeh Dadashzadeh Sangary, Mohammad Hassan Asayesh, Ali Asgharzadeh, Zahra Naghsh
pmc-12905973.description: BackgroundThe Ferrer-Urbina’s Multidimensional Scale of Sexual Self-Concept is newly designed and consists of an appropriate number of items. This scale has not been previously utilized in Iran. Thus, the present study aimed to evaluate the validity and reliability of its Persian version in Iran.

pmc-13217501.title: Nurse-led visual triage against histopathology in a real-world low-resource setting cervical cancer prevention program
pmc-13217501.creator: Simon M. Manga, Ivree Randolph, Lynda Ugwu, Grace Lee, Kathleen L. Nulah, Florence Manjuh, Comfort Ketu, Rebecca C. Arend
pmc-13217501.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Highlights•There is substantial burden of CIN2+ in a high‑risk population.•The nurse‑led visual triage, has potential for cervical cancer prevention in the absent of highly skilled personnel.•Nurse-led visual triage has good reliability in identifying ICC but poor for CIN2. Introduction Though cervical cancer is a highly preventable disease, it has remained the leading cause of death among women in resource limited settings (World Health Organization, 2014).
